premises: Radiation-induced defect clusters act as dislocation pinning sites in tungsten alloys at high temperature.
Dislocation pinning by defect clusters increases yield stress and strain hardening.
Increased strain hardening delays plastic strain localization.
Delayed plastic strain localization enhances toughness.
